findings.title: User-supplied formula is executed with new Function
findings.description: The tenant-editable formula string is compiled and run via new Function in the server process, giving any tenant admin arbitrary code execution (process.env, require('child_process'), fs). Parse the formula with a restricted expression evaluator (e.g. a small arithmetic parser or expr-eval) instead of evaluating JavaScript.
findings.suggestion: Replace new Function with a sandboxed arithmetic expression parser that only supports numbers, basePrice, qty and + - * / ().
